description: Assert or wait for an element, touching nothing: check exists, absent, text (equals), enabled, checked, focused, moves; expect: false for the opposite. timeoutMs (at most 15000) waits until it holds. Returns one line, or fails with CHECK_FAILED saying what it found. Whole screen: check_screen; look only: read_screen.
name: check_element
title: Check or wait for an element
